integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] One continuous photoreal cinematic live-action shot of the exact same adult Goku as the two approved photographs, the same youthful human face and worn torn orange gi over dark blue undershirt, sash, wraps and boots. Stable scratches, skin pores, cloth tears and stains. His ordinary human eyes have visible white sclera, small natural irises and clearly defined round dark pupils throughout the shot. The eyes are not lights: light comes from the aura outside his body. His original dark irises stay dark until the hair has become blond, then only the iris changes to a natural turquoise green, matching the supplied endpoint. The same Namek water remains left and rocks right. Both boots keep their original ground support and contact shadows. The low camera slowly moves forward a short distance with foreground parallax, then returns to the endpoint framing.
From 0 to 1.5 seconds, Goku inhales deeply through his nose, fists tight, head facing the same offscreen opponent. From 1.5 to 2.4 seconds, he lowers his hips and tightens his torso; dust begins lifting at his planted boots. From 2.4 to 4.45 seconds, he tilts his head upward and OPENLY YELLS: his jaw visibly drops, mouth opens wide, upper and lower teeth are visible with the dark oral cavity between them; the powerful continuous nonverbal shout comes from this clearly open mouth. His shoulders and neck visibly strain. Black hair erects into the iconic spikes, turns fully golden blond, and only then do the irises turn naturally turquoise, with black pupils still visible. The transparent golden ki aura swells around his whole body, casting warm light onto the same skin and cloth while loose gravel rises. By 4.45 seconds, the SSJ1 hair, eyes and aura match Picture 2. From 4.45 to 6.58 seconds, the yell releases naturally into a heavy breath, his jaw closes as he lowers his chin and fixes the exact same fierce gaze. The body stays alive and breathing, the sash flutters and the aura remains turbulent until the endpoint. Hair remains golden, eyebrows remain visible. The shot stays recognizably photographic. No text or extra people.

From 2.4 to 4.45 seconds, one raw powerful ADULT MALE NONVERBAL EXERTION YELL, no spoken words, no known actor imitation, accurately tied to the wide open mouth.
